privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy | Dental Clinic
privacy_page.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: Our dental clinic deeply values the privacy of your personal and medical data. This document outlines how we collect, utilize, and safeguard your information when you visit or interact with our platform.
privacy_page.sec1_text: When you browse, register, or use our website, we may collect the following types of information:
privacy_page.sec1_li3: Medical history overview and appointment preferences
privacy_page.sec2_text: The collected data is exclusively processed for the following operational purposes:
privacy_page.sec2_li1: Scheduling and managing your doctor appointments
privacy_page.sec2_li2: Administering and securing your user profile
privacy_page.sec2_li3: Sending clinic updates, newsletters, and educational blog posts
privacy_page.sec3_text: Your medical records are protected under strict patient-doctor confidentiality guidelines. We do not sell, trade, or share your data with third parties without your explicit written consent, unless required by law.
privacy_page.sec4_text: You reserve the right to review, update, modify, or permanently request the deletion of your personal records from our databases at any given time.
